0022600127.text: The Golden State Warriors (0-3) visit the Denver Nuggets (1-1) for their fourth game of the season, with the Warriors sitting fifth in the Pacific, three games back and 15th in the West, and on a three-game losing streak with an 0-2 road record. Denver is 1-0 at home, fourth in the Northwest and 8th in the West, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the most recent meeting a 116-93 Denver win in Denver on March 29, 2026. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), with Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee) and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions, while Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), with Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) also day-to-day game-time decisions.
